notes: Sign-in is optional. Anyone can browse the board and post a lost or found pet without an account; each post returns a private edit link. Posts are public user content. Every post has a menu (the ... button on a post) with Report post (emails the developer, who removes posts that break the rules within 24 hours), Hide post, and Block poster (hides all posts from that signed-in poster on this device). Account deletion is in the account screen.
